description: Fetches /llms.txt (or the llms.txt address given), validates it against the llmstxt.org proposal (one H1, optional summary, H2 sections of [name](url): notes links), tests up to eight of its links and reports whether llms-full.txt exists. States the evidence on how little the file is read. Free, no key. Docs: https://aeolookup.com/aeo-tools/llms-txt-validator/

check_links.description: Test up to eight of the file's links that are on its own site (default true).

url.description: The page or site to check, for example https://example.co.uk/ (https:// is added if missing).

name: validate_llms_txt
title: llms.txt validator
